newsitem.title: UK: Stakis says plans no more announcements yet.
newsitem.headline: Stakis says plans no more announcements yet.

text.p: Glasgow-based hotels and casinos group Stakis Plc denied market talk it would announce an acquisition on Friday, saying it planned no further announcement today other than its trading update.
Commmenting on media reports that Stakis would announce the purchase of Lonrho's Metropole hotels, Stakis said "market speculation begins to overtake reality."
"We have no plans to make an announcement in this moment," Stakis corporate affairs director Alex Pagett told Reuters.
"The reason being here is that market speculation begins to overtake reality," he added, while declining to confirm Stakis was actually in talks with Lonrho.
"There is a hell of a lot of speculation out there which we're not commenting on," said Pagett.
Stakis earlier reported an increase in fourth quarter turnover in both its hotels and casinos divisions.
